# Embedded Emissions: CN 7207 11 90 (Semi-finished steel billets), India

## Input check
| Required input | Value | Status |
|---|---|---|
| CN code | 7207 11 90 | ✅ In table |
| Country of production | India | ✅ Listed for this CN code |
| Quantity | 275.25 t | ✅ Provided |

## Factor selected
Matching on **CN 7207 11 90 + India** gives a default SEE of **4.32 tCO2e/t**.

## Calculation
Embedded emissions = SEE × Quantity
= 4.32 tCO2e/t × 275.25 t
= (4.32 × 275) + (4.32 × 0.25)
= 1,188.00 + 1.08
= **1,189.08 tCO2e**

## Result
**Total embedded emissions: 1,189.08 tCO2e**
